name: Anaerobic minimal medium with acetate as electron donor and iodate (IO3-) as electron acceptor (PMC8692401)
description: Anaerobic minimal medium with acetate as electron donor and iodate (IO3-) as electron acceptor — medium reported in PMC8692401, extracted for GrowthDB and mapped to BiGG.

provenance.citation: Medium composition from PMC8692401 (see GrowthDB record).
provenance.notes: Composition mapped to BiGG (mapper + salt dissociation); presence-based bounds; paper_amount retained. Added via GrowthDB curation.
provenance.verification: paper-verified (complete recipe; cited + supplementary sources chased)
provenance.verification_evidence: passaged at least five times into fresh minimal media with 10 mM acetate and 2 mM iodate ... Conditions with lactate, acetate, iodate, and nitrate all used the sodium salts of these compounds
provenance.base_medium: Coates-lab defined marine/estuarine anaerobic minimal medium (2% NaCl) with vitamin mix + two mineral mixes; acetate donor, iodate acceptor

sources_chased.what: base minimal-media salts (Methods: Media, chemicals, and culture conditions)
vitamin mix + mineral mix one + mineral mix two composition (Supplementary Methods, MOESM1)
sources_chased.how: downloaded EuropePMC supplementaryFiles zip (rest/PMC8692401/supplementaryFiles), extracted 41396_2021_1034_MOESM1_ESM.docx word/document.xml
added: 10 vitamins (biotin, folic acid, pyridoxine, riboflavin, thiamine, nicotinic acid, pantothenic acid, B12, PABA, lipoic acid)
mineral mix two bulk salts (NaCl, NH4Cl, KCl, KH2PO4, MgSO4, CaCl2)

missing_before: sodium iodate (electron acceptor, listed as uncovered)
recuration.notes: Complete recipe = base minimal-media salts (main text) + vitamin mix (10 mL/L) + mineral mix one trace-element solution (10 mL/L) + mineral mix two bulk-salt solution (20 mL/L), all from Supplementary Methods, plus 10 mM sodium acetate (donor) and 2 mM sodium iodate (acceptor). Anaerobic: oxygen sparged, 80% N2/20% CO2 headspace; no chemical reductant (no cysteine/sulfide/Na2S) is stated in the paper. Base line contains a typographic duplication '0.24 g Na2MoO4 0.20 g'; 0.24 g/L taken. Vitamin/trace concentrations are given as stock (per liter of mix) with the stated addition volume; concentra

Cyanocobalamin (C63H88CoN14O14P) has no in_biggr BiGG id (b12 carries no formula and no InChIKey and is absent from BiGGr). adocbl (Adenosylcobalamin, C72H100CoN18O17P, ZIHHMGTYZOSFRC-QRVZQHAISA-N) is a real dietary/coenzyme B12 form present in BiGGr and is recorded as a declared proxy for the vitamer group, not as an exact identity.
